description.en: The region in which the data lake resides.

description.zh:
若新增的分区名称与已有的分区名称重复，是否忽略该异常。取值：

- true：忽略。

- false：不忽略。
description.en:
If the new partition name duplicates an existing partition name, ignore the exception. Values:

- true: Ignore.

- false: Do not ignore.

description.zh: 是否需要返回分区信息，为true时结果会返回Partitions。
description.en: Return partition information. If set to true, the Partitions field is returned.

> To view the tenant ID, hover over the profile picture in the upper-right corner of the Data Management (DMS) console. For more information, see [View tenant information](~~181330~~).
